item.title: Former Jets 1st-round pick Darron Lee charged with 1st-degree murder in Tennessee
item.description: Former New York Jets player Darron Lee has been arrested in Tennessee and charged with first-degree murder. Authorities identified him as the suspect in the death of his girlfriend and took him into custody on Thursday. The Hamilton County sheriff's office reported the incident. The victim's identity has not been released. Lee, a former Ohio State linebacker, was the Jets' 20th overall pick in 2016.
